fusions.name: Blooded as One
fusions.desc: A lunging bite that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: See Them Off
fusions.desc: Snaps at everything close, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Keep Vigil
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Half-Wild Companion
fusions.desc: A bonded wolfdog fights beside you, striking an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
